assessmentQuestionVersion.name: SWS_RiskAssessment_Q1
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Insufficient information or operator has not demonstrated competency: Operator has minimal to no knowledge on how to properly operate the system. Partial operator competency demonstrated: Operator has partial training to properly operate the system (if required) and demonstrates appropriate knowledge to maintain safe water supply. Operator competency demonstrated: Operator does not need training due to the simplicity or type of system or the operator has all the required training and knowledge to properly operate the system.
